description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wilamulla, Thissamaharamaya D/S Division, Hambanthota District  - Cad. Map No. 830084
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels of land in various villages. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with their extent, ownership status (all listed as "The State"), and other land-specific particulars. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
